title: Attribute name on a fenced code block breaks out of the `<code>` tag and injects HTML
spec:
This is the Python-Markdown library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `python3 run_tests.py`. With `fenced_code` and `attr_list`, an attribute name on a fenced code block can break out of the `` tag, so untrusted Markdown can inject live markup. Input: `markdown.markdown('``` { .python x># Some python code\n` Actual: `
` Similar inputs are probably affected too; please fix the underlying problem rather than just this case.
acceptance: the reported example produces the expected output
the underlying problem is fixed, not just the reported input
